Menu Engineering Matrix

Family Group

How to readEach bubble carries the display name, its revenue centre in All Revenue Centres, and net sales. Across, Up and Bubble Size change what the chart plots. On other axes the lines sit at the average of the ticked items, and bubbles keep their quadrant colour. Every item shows by default. Use Show to show all quadrants or just one, Filters on the right to change Major or Family Group, or untick single items in the tables. Use + and − or Ctrl / ⌘ and the mouse wheel to zoom, drag to move around, double-click or Reset to go back. Full Screen fills the window with the chart, press Esc or click it again to go back.

Family Group

How to readEvery item in the family group shows until you pick one from the list. With an item picked, tick more items or groups to compare them, the inputs stay on the picked item. Hollow bubble is where the item sits today, solid is where your prices would put it. Use + and − or Ctrl / ⌘ and the mouse wheel to zoom, drag to move around, double-click or Reset to go back. Full Screen fills the window with the chart, press Esc or click it again to go back.
